name: Vanth
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the approximate radius Horizons carries for this satellite solution; these are not measured axes.
credit: JPL Horizons TNO satellite solution tnosat_v001_20090482_jpl043_20220908: header radius RAD~ 221.5 km for Vanth
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the approximate 221.5 km radius in the header of JPL Horizons' satellite solution for Vanth. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no pole or rotation state is adopted.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Vanth is a moon of Orcus, found in 2005. JPL's orbit for it rests on 12 observations from 2005 to 2015.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the roughly 221.5 km radius JPL lists. Shape, pole and rotation are not measured.
